title: One project owns one paper with non-destructive adoption and multiple experiments
user_story: The researcher can use the existing native environment with honest state, durable evidence and retained integrated engines.

requirements.description: Adoption is idempotent, keeps experiments, and moves/deletes no files.
A changed inventory invalidates the reviewed adoption digest.
Missing legacy tables are unknown, not zero, without mutating schema.
Ambiguous historical ownership blocks adoption without guessing or data loss.
Schema migration retains old producer IDs, logical backup and foreign-key integrity.
Empty inventory avoids DB allocation and repeat inventory is stable; no latency/scale claim.

nonfunctional: Preserve native L1-L4/memory/workflow/data and PaperOrchestra; no duplicate research engine.
Software fixtures never qualify live providers or scientific conclusions.
Coverage target100% is informational; every mandatory regression must execute and PASS.
postconditions: No silent fallback or fabricated completion
All historical producers and retained files remain identifiable
dependencies: Existing native gateway, workspace, mission and evidence infrastructure
